headline: Kuura Strand Turns Colonial as Weathered Expanse Rekindles
war_summary: The lines have shifted in the north-west: Kuura Strand, where five of six works stood Warden at the last edition, now reports four Colonial against two Warden, with five actions in the past two hours and the day's fighting there little abated. The Gutter, lately settled to Colonial colors, has gone quiet in the last two hours, though eight actions were logged in six and seventy-three across the day. The Weathered Expanse is again the war's furnace — fourteen actions in two hours, more than any other sector, about Spirit Watch, Frostmarch and Crow's Nest — its lines still four Warden, three Colonial and two unclaimed, at a day's cost of 7,039 Colonial and 8,435 Warden casualties. Marban Hollow reports eight actions in two hours around Checkpoint Bua and Oster Wall, Pari Peak four, Linn Mercy five. Olavis Wake and Palantine Berm have banked. Colonials now hold 323 works to the Warden 107, with six unclaimed.
